subject: Your Password Has Been Reset - $system_name
body:
Dear $display_name,

Your password for the $system_name has been successfully reset using your security questions.

What changed:
  - Your previous password has been invalidated
  - A temporary password has been issued
  - You will be asked to set a new password on your next login

Account Details:
  Username:   $username
  Email:      $email
  Reset Time: $reset_time

If you did not request this password reset, please contact your system administrator immediately as someone may have access to your security question answers.

For your security:
  - Change your password as soon as possible
  - Consider updating your security questions
  - Never share your password or security answers with anyone

-- $system_name Support
